reason: A bundled DSH extension suite providing browser control, provider authentication, usage and quota reporting, vision and UI tools, notifications, sidebar enhancements, theming, and agent presets; the broadest user-facing purpose is general utility enhancement.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件合集，整合浏览器控制、订阅登录、用量统计、视觉工具、界面增强、通知和 Agent 预设等功能。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle that combines browser control, subscription login, usage reporting, vision tools, interface enhancements, notifications, and agent presets.

capabilities: Controls a real browser through a local daemon and browser extension
Performs OAuth-based subscription sign-in and stores provider credentials through DSH
Reads local session logs and aggregates usage and cost data
Calls external model, pricing, quota, and vision service APIs
Changes the DSH interface, panels, notifications, and agent session rules
Installs multiple plugins and optional agent presets into a DSH profile
